about.text: Duphalac is a brand name of lactulose, sold as a syrup.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: The liquid form of the same isomerised lactose: the syrup is the purified reaction liquid, standardised to 667 g/l, so the other sugars of the process stay in it in small, capped amounts. That is why it is not given in galactosaemia.
